Use exactly this piece, not any other artwork. WHITE PAWN with a large perfectly round ivory sphere head, fine gold edge and collar ring, short tapered ivory stem and round gold-trimmed base with an amber diamond; no crown/cross. No grid lines, borders, text, numbers, labels or watermark. Genuine alpha TRANSPARENT background, no painted backdrop. At least 10% empty clear margins on every cell edge and a clean transparent gutter. Every body/effect/fragment completely isolated inside its own cell. No pixels spilling into neighboring cells.
ACTION: FOUR chronological frames of the piece CAPTURING an enemy, attacker-only. Frame1 anticipation: whole intact piece gently leans BACK 4 degrees, a small magic ring tight at base. Frame2 strike: same rigid piece leans FORWARD RIGHT by 10 degrees, x shifts at most 3% cell width, one SHORT thin curved magic trail behind the base. Frame3 contact: same body in the forward pose, one COMPACT bright impact glint in front of the lower-right side at x=76%,y=65%, no larger than 15% cell width, a few tiny energy diamond specks. Frame4 recovery: the same full unbroken piece is upright again in the same center/scale as frame1, trail subsides to a faint base ring. It must end ready to go into idle. Only this single intact attacker per cell. No victim, no cracks/destruction on the attacker, no giant explosion/crescent/cloud/wall of magic, no severed parts, no missing crown, no duplicated heads or random foreign chess piece. Magic stays compact, subordinate to the full readable body.
